name: a closing instruction and the wordmark
looks: A short two-part instruction fades in, the second half in the accent colour, over the tally-mark watermark. It cuts to the mark and wordmark settled on a plain field, with the site's address fading in beneath, a cursor blinking at its end.
build: The instruction's two halves fade in with a short gap between them, the second in the accent colour; the mark/wordmark fade/scale in on the cut; the address fades in last with a blinking cursor glyph, holding at least 1s.
sound: A soft rise under the instruction, a confirm tone as the wordmark lands, the bed fading out under the hold.
prompt: Fade in a short two-part closing instruction, the second half in the accent colour, over the brand's watermark, then cut to the mark and wordmark settled on a plain field with the site's address fading in beneath, a cursor blinking at its end; hold the finished card.
